title: WorkspaceDocument
description: Canonical authored workspace files. Model and evidence references are resolved by readModel; unknown facts are omitted and reported as gaps. uniqueIds/uniqueChildIds are generic keywords registered by the shared Ajv loader.

AuthoredCite.description: Evidence id, home-key code reference (with optional commit/span/symbol), or an inherited handler line span. Git-host URLs are derived, never authored here.

layer.description: kind: cache: where the layer sits on the cache path (outermost first)

granularity.description: kind: cache: whole responses, or per entity per subgraph fetch (Apollo Router entity caching)

keyed_by.description: kind: cache: what the key is made of, in words

purge.description: how an entry is emptied (surrogate key per sku, POST /invalidate)

invalidated_by.description: events that empty it (a shortcut; a flow step with purges: says who does it)

layer.description: kind: cache: where the layer sits on the cache path (outermost first)

granularity.description: kind: cache: whole responses, or per entity per subgraph fetch (Apollo Router entity caching)

keyed_by.description: kind: cache: what the key is made of, in words

purge.description: how an entry is emptied (surrogate key per sku, POST /invalidate)

invalidated_by.description: events that empty it (a shortcut; a flow step with purges: says who does it)

ref.description: a reference to another record: sch:* (its key) or sch:*#field

subgraphs.description: the subgraphs that resolve the field; required unless it is a key field

shareable.description: @shareable: two or more subgraphs resolve it

provides.description: @provides: fields of the return type this subgraph can resolve on the same fetch

requires.description: @requires: fields the gateway must fetch first and send along

override.description: @override: this field moves from another subgraph; percent = progressive override (null once the move is contracted)

reads.description: the record fields the owning subgraph reads

cache.description: data caches the resolver reads first

auth.description: who may read it; non-empty makes the field private

batched.description: overrides the subgraph's batching for this field

usage.description: registry field usage (evidence for a deprecation)

batching.description: request-scoped batching of entity lookups; none makes a list fetch an N+1

latency_ms.description: p50 of one fetch to this subgraph, in ms (a measurement, not a setting); lets the waterfall draw bars to scale

cache_control_default.description: seconds; the max-age a field without a hint takes (0 = uncacheable)

terms.description: other words that mean the same thing in prose; the plural of name is added automatically

means.description: markdown; what it is in business terms. The first sentence is the tooltip. May cite [[id]]

born_in.description: the system of record: where its id is minted

as.description: verb phrase read as '<name> <as> <to>', e.g. 'is selected by'

at.description: the schema, field or store that holds it

introduced_by.description: set when the plan introduces the concept

screen.description: the screen (or region) the person is on when this step happens; makes the flow a UI journey

case.description: via gql: only: which cache case the flow narrates (hit = the outermost layer answers; miss = it misses and the next answers; cold = every layer misses)

purges.description: cache stores this step empties (the acting service must own them or have access)

cacheControl.description: the cache hint the subgraph returns for the field (@cacheControl)

cacheUse.description: a cache layer attached to what it caches: on an operation, an edge/gateway override; on a graph field, a data cache the resolver reads first

ttl.description: seconds; on an operation an override of the derived max-age (give a reason)

key.description: what the layer keys on: free text, or { operation: id|hash, variables: all|[names], headers: [names] }
